purpose: Visual language specification board showing breathing-arc motif system
prompt:
Professional industrial design visual language specification board for an elderly AI companion device. Theme: "breathing-arc" motif system.

Layout: Visual language board on warm cream background (#F5F0E8). Three sections arranged horizontally, each showing one motif element with examples.

Section 1 — "breath-ring" (left third):
Show 3 concentric circular arcs with varying opacity (100% → 60% → 30%) in glow-amber #E8B87A on cream background. The arcs suggest a gentle pulse/breathing rhythm. Below: small diagram showing the arcs as they appear on the physical LED ring of the device. Parameters noted: "3 arcs, 8mm spacing, Gaussian falloff"

Section 2 — "pebble-curve" (center third):
Show 4-5 organic silhouette curves derived from river stone/pebble shapes. Each curve is G2 continuous, asymmetric (5-15% offset from center), with minimum 12mm radius. Drawn in text-charcoal #3D3832 on cream. Show the evolution from natural pebble photo reference to abstracted product silhouette. Below: "No inflection points, no sharp transitions"

Section 3 — "warm-glow" (right third):
Show 3 soft radial gradient studies — glow-amber #E8B87A center fading to transparent edge with Gaussian falloff. Maximum 80% opacity (always diffused, never harsh). Show how the glow appears at different intensities representing different emotional states: breathing (slow pulse), listening (brighter), reminding (gentle pulse).

Bottom strip: A continuous pebble-curve organic line used as a section divider, with the rule: "All curves G2 continuous — no sharp transitions anywhere. No geometric patterns — only organic forms."

Style: professional design language board, abstract and artistic but systematic, warm tones, editorial quality. Like a page from a premium industrial design portfolio.
